messages:
Jamie: Starting a short follow-up thread for the GTM section of today's all-hands. Drop quick questions about pipeline, partner launch, or pricing and we'll answer live. :speech_balloon:
Maria: Quick status: healthy funnel but longer cycles. A few late-stage enterprise opps pushed to Q3; mid-market is driving volume.
Sanjay: On discounting: are CS/renewal discounts being treated differently than new business this quarter?
Maria: Renewals get tighter guardrails. We approved a small discretionary +5% uplift for strategic renewals with CSM + Sales Ops approval. Anything beyond needs VP signoff.
Riley: Sales ops asks: will SKU docs include example invoices for Dedicated reserved capacity? Helps procurement.
Olivia: Yes, we'll include sample invoice lines and an overage calculation example in the SKU packet. Sales Ops will get the draft by EOD tomorrow.
Leah: Partner question: when do we enable co-sell in EMEA and what are certification steps?
Leah: Co-sell for Partner Growth tier starts May 15. Certification = completion of two enablement modules + a demo sign-off. We'll publish a partner FAQ and enablement playbook next week.
Jamie: GK for reps: if a partner is unregistered but brings a deal, what's the credit split?
Leah: Unregistered partner = 5% finder's credit upon registration within 30 days. Registered partners get the full revenue share per the tier.
Sanjay: Messaging ask: what's the one-liner about cost/quantization for proposal decks? Ops wants a plain sentence.
Olivia: Use: "Redwood provides model and quantization profiles that can reduce inference costs up to ~40% for high-throughput apps while keeping output quality." Keep it non-tech.
Maria: Forecast tweak: we'll start weekly roll-ups for the top 25 deals effective Friday. Sales leads, please publish the RFC by EOD Thursday.
Riley: Partner pilot metric: how do we define a "qualified opportunity" for the 3-opp/quarter requirement?
Leah: Qualified = customer commitment to a POC or signed NDA + named AE/partner in CRM. Full definition will be in the partner kit.
Jamie: Action items: (1) Leah to drop partner kit + FAQ next week, (2) Sales Ops to circulate SKU docs and invoice examples tomorrow, (3) Olivia to post the 1-line cost blurb in #sales now.
all-hands-bot: Reminder: recording and slides will be in the all-hands folder within 24h.
Jamie: Thanks all. If you need follow-ups, tag Maria/Leah or add to this thread and we'll triage in the GTM huddle. :handshake:
